Micro Eazy ecosystem · AI infrastructure · 14 September 2026

Riri answers first

The customer app now has the console's device in its bottom-right corner, and the first contact a Micromart customer has with their lender is Riri, reading their own account. She resolves what she can, hands over what she cannot with her working shown, and every hand-off lands in the officer's queue already triaged. This page is what was built on top of Sprint 0, how to show it tomorrow, and what is still yours to decide.

PREPARED FOR Faith Birgen FOR Micromart demo · 15 Sep 2026 READS WITH One Riri · 11 Sep 2026 STATUS Built · uncommitted · not deployed
01

Before the demo — three steps, in order

  1. Commit and push both repositories Yours

    Nothing is deployed. Both changes are in the working trees of connected-suite (the server, Riri's brain and the console) and micro-eazy-app (the dock). The app calls routes that only exist after the console deploys, so push the console first and let Vercel finish before the app.

    # PowerShell, one line at a time. Console first; wait for its Vercel build.
cd C:\GIT\MICRO_EAZY\connected-suite
git add -A
git commit -m "Riri first response"
git push

cd C:\GIT\MICRO_EAZY\micro-eazy-app
git add -A
git commit -m "Riri dock"
git push

  2. No database change is needed Checked

    Knowledge packs are versioned in the existing OrgConfig store, customer questions are logged in the existing RiriQueryLog, and hand-offs are ordinary conversation rows with a new author value. No migration, no DDL, no re-seed.

  3. Optional environment variables Defaults work

    • RIRI_HANDOFF_SECRET — signs cross-system links. Falls back to a key derived from NEXTAUTH_SECRET.
    • PORTAL_APP_URL / CONSOLE_APP_URL — default to portal. and lms.servicesuitecloud.com.
    • RIRI_LLM_KEY — only for questions nothing recognises. Without it she says honestly she doesn't know and offers a person. Every money answer is deterministic either way.
02

The demo, in six questions

Signed in as a real Micromart customer on a laptop. Each step shows one property the plan promised; the right-hand column is what to say.

Table 1 · Demo script
#Do thisWhat happensWhat it proves
1Open the app. Point at the bubble bottom-right.Riri's nudge: “Ask me anything about your Micromart loan. If I can't sort it out, I'll get you to a person.”She is the first contact, and she says what happens when she fails before anyone asks.
2Ask “What do I owe?”The balance, the product and the clearance date, read from Micromart's book, with an Open Repay button and a “From your account” stamp.The same read Home renders — they cannot disagree. No model involved.
3Ask “Do I need to dial *334# for Ratiba?”Answered from Safaricom's agreement, stamped platform.ratiba v1. No thread opened.The plan's Sprint 2 “done when”, verbatim.
4Ask “When is my next payment?”She gives the balance and says the instalment schedule isn't on the feed she can read — and she won't work one out. Offers a person.She never states a figure she didn't read. This is the trap a confident chatbot falls into.
5Ask “I paid but my balance has not changed.” Press Hand this to the team, add a note.Case ME-XXXXXX opens. Switch to the console → Customer Messages.The officer sees what was asked, what Riri checked, which pack she used, and the one thing a person must decide — in a violet triage card, at the top of “Needs a reply”.
6In the console, open Riri Knowledge. Ask the preview “What fees do you charge?”The starter pack answers, stamped as unreviewed. Load it and press Validate — it refuses until Micromart's KRA PIN is entered, because the PIN owns the facts.Micromart trains Riri on its own JSON without us, every answer names the pack version, and a pack that describes our screens is refused.

Kiswahili works throughout

“Nadaiwa kiasi gani?”, “Ratiba ni nini?”, “Nataka kuongea na mtu” — the record answers, the Ratiba answer and the instant hand-off all come back in Kiswahili. Worth one question in the room.

05

What holds her honest

Money answers are code, not a model

first-response.ts · 98 pinned cases

  • Balance, due date, limit, score, savings, application, Ratiba, KYC and messages are read from the record and formatted — never computed into a new claim.
  • A bridged loan's next instalment is refused, not derived.
  • An unreachable book never renders as zero.
  • A past clearance date is refused (Loans.DateCleared is empty).

The model is fenced when it runs at all

figuresGrounded()

  • Only questions nothing recognised reach it, with the customer's own facts and nothing else.
  • Any shilling figure or percentage in its answer that is not in those facts voids the answer.
  • The triage note an officer reads is re-derived on the server at hand-off — never assembled in the browser.
06

Decisions and limits worth knowing tonight

  • The Micromart pack is a starter, and says so. It was assembled from Micromart's published terms and the fee sheet read on 13 Sep (Chap Chap 8.25%/week; PF KSh 400; Micro Eazy PF 6% clamped 650–6,000; CRB KSh 100; late fee 20%). Every answer from it is stamped “Starter pack”. Micromart should review each figure and publish it as theirs.
  • Micromart's KRA PIN is not recorded anywhere in the estate. The starter's owner is a placeholder; a published pack cannot go live until someone at Micromart enters the PIN in Riri Knowledge. Not guessed.
  • Next instalment is not on the feed for bridged customers (the schedule table has no index on the loan). Riri says so. Fixing it is a data road, not a Riri change.
  • Pay now is still token-gated for code-door customers (existing limitation). Riri sends them to Repay; she does not press it.
  • Escalations reach the Customer Messages queue, not a named officer — the plan's open question, decided by default. Revisit when the deflection panel has a week of rows.
  • Verification done: both repos type-check; router 68/68, knowledge 74/74, map 67/67, first response 98/98; production builds of both pass (next build, vite build). A real request went through the built console on a native test org (synctest-ms1v1f4j) — opener, a Ratiba answer from the platform pack and a balance from the record, about 2.8 s each from this machine; it logged two rows under that org only. Screens were checked in the dev preview in both themes and at phone width.
  • Not done: an end-to-end run against Micromart's live book through a real customer session — that needs an OTP to a real handset. Do one pass yourself before the room: ask “What do I owe?”, then “I want to talk to a person”, and open that case in the console.
